sentences.text: Today, we will talk about Turkey.
Turkey is a large, beautiful, and historic country between Europe and Asia.
Let's learn about it in slow and easy English.
Where is Turkey?
Turkey is in both Europe and Asia.
A small part is in Europe and the rest is in Asia.
It is next to Greece, Bulgaria, Georgia, Armenia, Iran, Iraq, and Syria.
Turkey has coasts on the Aegean Sea, the Mediterranean Sea, and the Black Sea.
What is the capital city of Turkey?
The capital city is Ankara.
Ankara is in the center of the country.
It is the home of the government and many important buildings.
The largest city is Istanbul.
Istanbul is in both Europe and Asia.
It has bridges, mosques, markets, and a lot of history.
Other big cities are Izmir, Antalya, Bursa, and Gaziantep.
How many people live in Turkey?
More than 85 million people live in Turkey.
It is one of the most populated countries in Europe and the Middle East.
People live in cities, towns, and villages.
Turkey has many cultures, languages, and traditions.
What language do people speak in Turkey?
People speak Turkish.
It is the official language.
Some people also speak Kurdish, Arabic, Laz, or other local languages.
English is taught in schools and is spoken in tourist areas.
What is the weather like in Turkey?
Turkey has many different climates.
In the west and south, summers are hot and dry, winters are mild.
In the north, it is green and rainy.
In the east, winters are cold and snowy.
Turkey has four seasons with hot summers and cold winters in many places.
What does Turkey look like?
Turkey has mountains like Mount Ararat, beaches and blue seas, lakes, forests, and rivers, old cities and ancient ruins, beautiful areas like Cappadocia, Pamukkale, and Ephesus.
It is a country with both nature and history.
What animals live in Turkey?
You can see sheep, goats, cows, and horses.
Cats and dogs, especially in the streets of Istanbul.
Birds, foxes, and wolves in the wild.
Bears and eagles in the mountains.
People love and take care of street animals, especially cats.
What do people eat in Turkey?
Turkish food is rich, fresh, and delicious.
People eat bread, rice, and bulgur.
Meat, chicken, and fish, vegetables, yogurt, and olive oil.
Popular dishes, kebabs, grilled meat, doma, stuffed vegetables, or grape leaves.
Pide Turkish flatbread like pizza.
Menemen, eggs with tomato and pepper.
Baklava, sweet pastry with nuts and syrup.
What do people drink in Turkey?
People drink chai, black tea, and small glasses.
Turkish coffee, strong and rich.
Iran, salty yogurt drink.
Fruit juice, water.
Tea is part of everyday life in Turkey.
What is life like in Turkey?
Life in Turkey is social and family focused.
People enjoy spending time with family, eating meals together, going to cafes and markets, walking by the sea, celebrating holidays and festivals.
Turkish people are known for their hospitality.
Guests are very welcome.
What are some holidays and traditions in Turkey?
National Sovereignty Day, April 23rd.
Victory Day, August 30th, Republic Day.
October 29th, Ramazan by Rama, Feet, End of Ramadan.
Kerban by Rama et alara, with animal sacrifice and sharing.
People also enjoy folk music, dances, and traditional clothes in village festivals.
Some fun facts about Turkey.
Istanbul was once called Byzantium and Constantinople.
Turkish delight is a famous sweet.
The Turkish flag is red with a white moon and star.
Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque, and Topkapi Palace are world famous.
The first ever coffee house opened in Istanbul.
Now you know many things about Turkey.
You know where it is, what people speak, and what they eat.
You learned about the weather, traditions, food, and history.
Great job!
Thank you for listening to the Slow English Podcast.
I am Emily.
